    std::string s;
    std::cin >> s;
    int ans = 0;
    for (int i = 0; i < 100000000; i += 25) {
        std::string test = std::to_string(i);
        if (test.length() != s.length()) continue;
        int xDigit = -1;
        bool works = true;
        for (size_t j = 0; j < s.length(); ++j) {
            if (s[j] == 'X') {
                if (xDigit == -1) xDigit = test[j];
                if (test[j] != xDigit) {
                    works = false;
                    break;
                }
            } else if (s[j] != '_') {
                if (test[j] != s[j]) {
                    works = false;
                    break;
                }
            }
        }
        if (works) ++ans;
    }
    std::cout << ans << std::endl;
    return 0;
}
